summary: Join our Restaurant and Hospitality Safety and Compliance Course. Ensure your team is prepared to meet safety standards and provide a secure environment.
lede: Restaurant compliance training gives hospitality and foodservice teams practical methods for managing food, workplace and guest safety in daily operations. It is suited to people responsible for safety, audits or operations, and covers HACCP-based food safety, allergen and cross-contamination controls, hazard assessments, chemical handling, fire and emergency planning, supplier traceability, and digital compliance records. Participants also develop monitoring plans, inspection checklists and a safety roadmap.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for maintaining the integrity, safety, and legal standing of hospitality and foodservice establishments.
modules: Hospitality Safety Foundations and HACCP Integration
Food Hygiene and Pathogen Control Strategies
Workplace Safety and OSHA Standards in Hospitality
Chemical Safety and COSHH Compliance Management
Fire Safety and Emergency Response Planning
Liquor Licensing and Responsible Service Compliance
Supplier Management and Supply Chain Traceability
Physical Security and Guest Protection Management
Integrated Safety Strategy and Stakeholder Reporting
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2 years of experience in a hospitality supervisory or management role. Familiarity with basic food hygiene concepts is recommended. No prior experience with digital compliance tools is required, as these will be covered in the course.
